about: The S7 drawing tasks (docs/THIN_SLICE_PLAN.md, 3.2 S7) on the thin slice's parts. Each task's success is checked by scripts/mcp-eval/check.mjs on the resulting Spec and its Plan. A quantity is a dimension's ID without its 'd:' prefix and '@<view>' suffix (d:<feature>/<parameter>), so the checks hold for the view-free IDs S1 introduces too.

tasks.source: S7 example: move the hole callouts to the right of the plan view and pin them
tasks.prompt: On the mounting plate's drawing, move the three hole callouts of the plan view (6× ⌀6.6 THRU, ⌀8 THRU and ⌀4.2 THRU) to the right of the plan view and pin them there, so that later layout changes do not move them.

tasks.source: S7 example: hide the redundant width dimension
tasks.prompt: On part 10127's drawing, hide the overall width dimension (28.8): it is not wanted on this drawing. Every other dimension must stay.

tasks.source: S7 example: fix every problem near the bore (here, near the first slot)
tasks.prompt: On NIST CTC-01's drawing, fix every problem reported against the first slot's dimensions (f:slot:1) without hiding any dimension: change placement, sheet or scale as needed.

tasks.source: S7 example: change sheet and scale and keep intent
tasks.prompt: On GRM-03's drawing, put a ±0.02 tolerance on the ø5 step diameter and leave out the isometric view. Then change the drawing to an A3 sheet at 5:1, keeping both decisions.

tasks.source: own: a fit on a hole, read back from the drawn label
tasks.prompt: On part 10127's drawing, give the ⌀8.094 through hole an H7 fit, so that its callout shows the fit.

tasks.source: own: sheet, title block and view choice in one request
tasks.prompt: On the mounting plate's drawing, leave out the isometric view, use an A4 sheet at 1:1, and fill the title block with the title MOUNTING PLATE and drawing number DW-0001.

tasks.source: S7 example: moving a callout or dimension to another view
tasks.prompt: On the mounting plate's drawing, show the overall width (100) in the plan view instead of the front view, on the side of the plan view away from the front view.
